m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: The Oct15 Tetsuo baseline underwent 19 physical one-for-one swaps to the exact Oct27 100. The original M6 plan described 14 designed cases, not executed gameplay proof. Engineering PR #735's exact-source bounded 22 cases re-executed commander Aura/tapped-or-blocking/colored-payment/untap/copy interactions on the changed 100; this transfer applies only to their matched named conditions. Complete multiplayer grind W1 and original sealed I/J Phase B remain out of scope.

P0.oracle_source: Public Scryfall 2026-10-27T21:02Z Oracle bulk JSONL by GET, exact all-93 names / UBR Commander legality checked offline in focused CI
P0.payable_fixture: Tetsuo battlefield target of Aura spell vs Equipment equip, with UBBR activation condition separately asserted by K1 case.
P0.positive_assertion: An Aura spell cannot target Tetsuo, while equip can target him; his printed ability can target eligible opposing creatures.
P0.adversarial_assertion: An already attached Aura need not fall off, and untapped nonblocker is not destroyable; activation covered by K1.
P0.coverage_note: Executed finite named-source and paid-cost fixture; not an independent M6/J game engine or deterministic multiplayer outcome.
